race.title: Sebden Steel Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: An interesting opener. A big-field bumper win at the spring festival here marks down DELAMOTTE as one who can do well over hurdles for his top stable. Kingstonian rates an obvious danger after 2 good placed efforts since switched to hurdles. Brady Hartsfield and Bacharach should have more to offer on the back of promising hurdle debuts. Point recruit Menethil is the mount of Jack Kennedy from the Gordon Elliott quintet. DELAMOTTE (FR) KINGSTONIAN BRADY HARTSFIELD (IRE)
